name: Present for five minutes
short_description: Deliver a structured five-minute presentation with an opening, two main points, and a close.
self_assessment: I can deliver a five-minute presentation with two main points without help or written sentences.
description: Deliver a structured five-minute presentation with an opening, two main points, and a close. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Explain a proposed change to a small group
